model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for three different configurations, namely Llama-3B, Llama-3B with Fine-Tuning (FT), and Llama 2B with FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and is scaled logarithmically with a base that seems to be close to 2, ranging from 10^6 to 10^9. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.2 to 0.8. Three lines represent the respective configurations: the Llama-3B is marked with blue stars and displays a generally increasing trend, starting around 0.35 at 10^6 completions and approaching 0.75 at 10^9; Llama-3B with FT is indicated by green triangles and presents a similar increasing trend, starting near 0.25 and nearing 0.7; Llama 2B with FT is highlighted by yellow squares and follows a rising trend from about 0.3 to nearly 0.65. The lines suggest that increasing the number of completions in these configurations leads to higher coverage, with Llama-3B configurations generally demonstrating higher coverage than Llama 2B with FT at equivalent completions.
